title: Protective effect of pteryxin on LPS-induced acute lung injury via modulating MAPK/NF-kappaB pathway and NLRP3 inflammasome activation.
authors: Xuan, Tian-Qi; Gong, Guohua; Du, Huanhuan; Liu, Chunyan; Wu, Yun; Bao, Guilan; Ma, Qianqian; Zhen, Dong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物pteryxin对LPS诱导急性肺损伤的保护作用，涉及MAPK/NF-kB通路和NLRP3炎症小体，分子对接仅用于小分子-蛋白结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Peucedanum praeruptorum seed root is a common medicinal herb with antipyretic, expectorant, antitussive, and therapeutic effects against bronchitis and furuncle. The roots of this herb contain many coumarin compounds, including pteryxin. AIM OF THIS STUDY: To investigate whether pteryxin can alleviate the LPS-induced lung injury and the mechanism involved. MATERIAL AND METHODS: Male BALB/C mice were orally given sodium carboxymethylcellulose (CMC-Na) (0.5%, 1mL/100g) and pteryxin (suspended in CMC-Na; 0.5%) at 5, 10, 25 mg/kg once daily for 7 days. Subsequently, the mice received a single intratracheal instillation of 5 mg/kg LPS or saline as the control. After 8 hours, the mice were sacrificed to collect bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) and lung tissues. These samples were used to determine the lung W/D (wet/dry) weight ratio, total protein (TP) levels, inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, TNF-alpha, and IL-1beta) and expression of protein involved in MAPK/NF-kappaB pathway and NLRP3 inflammasome. H&E staining was carried out on tissue sections to explore the pathological alterations induced by LPS. The protein expression of F4/80 and NLRP3 in lung tissues was analyzed using immunohistochemical staining. The binding of pteryxin to target proteins (MAPK, NF-kappaB and NLRP3) was determined based on molecular docking tests. RESULTS: Treatment with pteryxin reduced the lung W/D weight ratio, total protein (TP) level and levels of inflammatory cytokines (TNFalpha, IL-6 and IL-1 beta) significantly. Therefore, it ameliorated LPS-induced inflammatory response in BALB/C mice. Moreover, pteryxin suppressed LPS-induced upregulation of proteins involved in MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway and NLRP3 inflammasome activation. The expression level of F4/80 and NLRP3 was also downregulated by pteryxin pretreatment in lung tissues. Docking analysis revealed that pteryxin bound to target proteins (MAPK, NF- kappaB and NLRP3) with a fit-well pattern . CONCLUSION: Pteryxin may attenuate LPS-induced acute lung injury by dampening MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling and NLRP 3 inflammasome activation.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：白花前胡种子根是一种常见药材，具有解热、祛痰、止咳及治疗支气管炎和疖肿的功效。该植物根部含有多种香豆素类化合物，其中包括前胡素（pteryxin）。研究目的：探讨前胡素是否能减轻脂多糖（LPS）诱导的肺损伤及其相关机制。材料与方法：雄性BALB/C小鼠每日口服给予羧甲基纤维素钠（CMC-Na）（0.5%，1mL/100g）及前胡素（悬浮于0.5% CMC-Na中）5、10、25 mg/kg，连续7天。随后，小鼠接受单次气管内滴注5 mg/kg LPS或生理盐水作为对照。8小时后，处死小鼠，收集支气管肺泡灌洗液（BALF）和肺组织。这些样本用于测定肺湿/干（W/D）重量比、总蛋白（TP）水平、炎症细胞因子（IL-6、TNF-α和IL-1β）以及参与MAPK/NF-κB通路和NLRP3炎症小体的蛋白表达。对组织切片进行H&E染色，以探索LPS诱导的病理变化。通过免疫组织化学染色分析肺组织中F4/80和NLRP3的蛋白表达。基于分子对接测试确定前胡素与靶蛋白（MAPK、NF-κB和NLRP3）的结合情况。结果：前胡素处理显著降低了肺W/D重量比、总蛋白（TP）水平和炎症细胞因子（TNFα、IL-6和IL-1β）水平。因此，它改善了BALB/C小鼠中LPS诱导的炎症反应。此外，前胡素抑制了LPS诱导的MAPK/NF-κB信号通路和NLRP3炎症小体激活相关蛋白的上调。前胡素预处理还下调了肺组织中F4/80和NLRP3的表达水平。对接分析显示，前胡素以良好拟合模式与靶蛋白（MAPK、NF-κB和NLRP3）结合。结论：前胡素可能通过抑制MAPK/NF-κB信号传导和NLRP3炎症小体激活来减轻LPS诱导的急性肺损伤。
